items.title: Cuteness - Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
items.description: Cuteness refers to an appealing appearance and behavior. It is mostly associated with baby -like traits like round faces and large eyes. This can also apply to humans, animals, or objects. This often causes a biological desire to care for clumsy creatures. Cultural influences, like anime from Japan, can shape different views of cuteness.

items.description: The Kindchenschema is a specific set of physical and behavioral traits that trigger innate caregiving responses in humans and other animals. These traits, often characterized by large heads, round faces, and big eyes, are designed to evoke feelings of tenderness and protection.
